correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the four active transient states (2,0),(3,0),(2,1),(3,1), death and successful birth rates and exact absorption system; independently recomputed F=b^2J/D with J=a^2+5ab+21a+6b^2+45b+84 and D=a^2b^2+5ab^3+21ab^2+15ab+3a+6b^4+45b^3+141b^2+195b+108. Independent symbolic derivatives reproduce all three positive-monomial Hessian numerators (37,58,79 terms); determinant and -H_aa>0 on a,b>0. Endpoint derivative has sign Q_B(h); coefficient breakpoints 9,86/9,6714/493,405/13 strictly increase, Descartes plus Q_B(0)<0 and Q_B(1)>0 implies unique h threshold for B>9. Boundary m=0 gives F=0, b>0 F>0; strict log-concavity proves uniqueness. Finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The finite capacity-three two-patch model captures a mathematically motivated Allee/pair-formation bottleneck. A jointly strict log-concavity theorem and a sharp, fully classified dispersal-effort transition at B=9 are exact and potentially reusable optimization benchmarks, not a routine textbook rate derivative or a claim of indefinite establishment.
